description: This file is a Bash shell script used for testing and validating Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) support in curl against various servers and configurations. It performs network checks, invokes curl with different parameters, and verifies the ECH functionality through automated tests.

methods.name: whenisitagain

methods.description: Calculates the age of a file in seconds.

methods.description: Extracts the port number from a host:port string.

methods.name: cli_test
